digest.component_or_area: ticket transition/close path and reducer state fold
propositions: The current bug-close --reason free-text is validated but discarded and never persisted into ticket state.

A required --class enum flag replaces --reason on bug closes, with a bounded MECE vocabulary (regression, plan_defect, env_integration, flaky, preexisting, not_a_bug, duplicate, escalated, undetermined).
The close_class value must be folded into reduced ticket state via a new _fold_close_class helper in both fork-winner and normal-update branches so rebar show can query it.
The close guard exists at two sites (txn.py transition_core and transition_close.py _completion_precheck) and both must accept close_class.
Closing a bug without --class exits nonzero with stderr naming allowed enum values, and an out-of-enum value is rejected.
The close_class schema field is additive/optional so readers tolerate its absence and back-out is straightforward.
